toegepas.blok: Bronne oor nou en oor lank gelede
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'eendag' points to the future, so the verb should be 'word' (becomes), not 'is'.
toegepas.fout: 'is eendag' sits stiffly with a future time word; the photo becomes a source about the past
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'word eendag' is the natural Afrikaans copula for a future change of state and keeps the meaning exact.

laat_vaar.voor: Jy sien ook die huise en vervoer
laat_vaar.na: Jy sien ook die huise en die vervoer
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Repeating the article before the second noun reads more naturally in Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: One article governing both nouns reads naturally here; repeating it is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.voor: Soos by elke bron kyk jy aanlyn waar die inligting vandaan kom
na_skrywer.na: Aanlyn kyk jy, soos by elke bron, waar die inligting vandaan kom
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: As written, 'aanlyn' reads as if you check every source online; moving it to the front ties it to websites and sets the comparison off as an aside.
na_skrywer.fout: 'kyk jy aanlyn' can be read as checking every source online, when the sentence is about information found online on websites
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but the proposal settles a meaning question by choosing one reading and adds a clunky interjected clause for a Grade 4 reader, so the writer should decide the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Grawe is een van die maniere.
na_skrywer.na: Grawe is een manier om dit te doen.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'een van die maniere' has nothing to refer back to; 'een manier om dit te doen' ties it clearly to the searching and investigating in the sentence before.
na_skrywer.fout: 'die maniere' has no stated referent when the glossary entry is read alone
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition beyond spelling or grammar, so any fix must go through the writer for every lesson that uses it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: 'n Ou pot wys waarvan mense geëet het.
vlae.rede: Ambiguous: 'waarvan mense geëet het' can mean what people ate out of (the dishes) or what food they ate. I cannot pick one without guessing what the writer meant, so the writer should decide which.

vlae.teks: Plakkate wat klante wil lok, wys winkels op hul mooiste.
vlae.rede: This sentence comes without any link to the sentence before it about asking who made a source and why, so a learner may not see that it is an example of that point. Linking it is a structural choice, so the writer should make it.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry asks this outright. 'Voorwerpbron/voorwerpbronne' is a regular, easy-to-read Afrikaans compound (like 'bronmateriaal' or 'voorwerpnaam'), it fits a nine-year-old, and it works inside a sentence ('n geskrewe bron en 'n voorwerpbron'). I see no language reason to change it. It is unusual in reference works, but it is not wrong.
